channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Caliente Ballroom Celebrates Grand Opening in Mount Pleasant
item.description: Caliente Ballroom hasannounced the grand opening of its brand-new, 4,200 sq. ft. studio. Designed with dancers in mind, the state-of-the-art facility combines professional instruction with a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere for the entire community.

item.title: Pulitzer Prize-winner Jodi Kantor to Deliver the Milton and Freddie Kronsberg Memorial Lecture at the College of Charleston
item.description: Pulitzer Prize award-winning journalist Jodi Kantor will be speaking at the College of Charleston Simons Center for the Arts Recital Hall on March 11th at 7:00 PM to share about her life and career and talk about current events

item.title: Oceanfront Happy Hour at The Ellie Beach Resort to Sip into Spring
item.description: March is finally here, bringing milder temperatures and longer, sunnier days to the Grand Strand—the perfect excuse to toast the arrival of spring with an oceanfront happy hour.

item.title: Carolinas Credit Union League Promotes Billy Boylston to Chief Advocacy Officer
item.description: The Carolinas Credit Union League (CCUL) has promoted Billy Boylston to chief advocacy officer, recognizing his more than a decade of leadership advancing the League’s state and federal advocacy priorities across the Carolinas.

item.title: Vicious Biscuit Goes Wild for Blueberries with Bold Limited-Time Creations
item.description: Vicious Biscuit is bringing a burst of blueberry bliss to brunch this spring. From now through April 5, guests can enjoy three all-new limited-time blueberry creations available at all Vicious Biscuit locations.

item.title: Tamara Curry Announces Campaign for Charleston County Probate Judge
item.description: After more than 24 years serving Charleston County families as Associate Probate Judge, Tamara Curry announced her campaign for Charleston County Probate Judge, emphasizing experience, transparency, and compassionate service.

item.title: Bank Of America's "Museums On Us" Program Offering Cardholders Free Admission to IAAM and Gibbes Museums This Weekend
item.description: Bank of America, Merrill, and Bank of America Private Bank cardholders can receive free general admission to two of Charleston’s cultural attractions - The International African American Museum (IAAM) and Gibbes Museum of Art this weekend

item.title: Reliable Battery Powered Trikes For Navigating Tight Interior Spaces
item.description: Moving around inside a home can be tricky when space is limited. Small hallways and tight corners often create barriers for standard mobility aids. People often struggle to find a balance between stability and size.

item.title: Tri-County SPEAKS Expands Hotline Access Through Partnership with RAINN
item.description: Tri-County SPEAKS Sexual Assault Services (TCS) has entered a new partnership with the Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network (RAINN) to significantly expand access to its sexual assault hotline services across the Tri-County area.

item.title: Atlanta Jewish Film Festival Shifts to Virtual Cinema: Streaming to Metro Atlanta Homes and Audiences Statewide
item.description: Following its in-theater run across metro Atlanta, the 26th annual Atlanta Jewish Film Festival (AJFF) continues statewide with its Virtual Cinema, streaming March 6–15, 2026.
